محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن سعد بن زرارة الأنصاري
محمد بن عبد الرحمن بن سعد بن زرارة الأنصاري

notes: Three routes (Abu Bakr b. Abi Shayba, Muhammad b. Bashshar, Ahmad b. Said al-Darimi) meet at Shu'ba, which the text writes twice, and then share the tail. «محمد بن جعفر، غندر» is kept with the comma as the text writes it (Ghandar is a laqab, not merged). «يحيى» follows «عمي» (my uncle), a relation, so only the name is a link. The gloss between dashes is left out, and the Companion Sa'd is the subject of the story, not a transmitter, so he is not a link. The Prophet's words are the matn.
